text:
maya: Heads-up — after last night's canary we saw INT8-calibration rollout increase p99 for conv-heavy tails. Thinking we need SDK knobs + docs safety rails before full roll. I'll paste profiler highlights.

sahil: saw same. p50 ~ same, p95 +8%, p99 +22% on long-seq conv runs.

sahil: profiler snap:
```
kernel_select: FP8->INT8 fallback thrash: 360ms
quant_calib: per-layer calibration: 420ms (hot path)
kv_cache_merge: 45ms
batcher_wait: 18ms
```

loren: interesting — looks like kernel routing keeps switching when calibration state toggles mid-session. That causes cache/KV warmup to re-hit different kernels.

maya: yeah, observed many tiny batches with varying seq_len => kernel selection churn. KV cache warmup + recalib is killing p99.

loren: propose SDK exposure: `quant.mode` (`auto|off|force`), `quant.preset` (`safe|balanced|aggressive`), `quant.calibrate` (`true|false|'auto'`), `quant.safety` (`on|off`) and `quant.max_calib_time_ms`.

loren: example SDK usage:
```
client.generate({
  model: 'redwood/v1-large',
  quant: { mode: 'auto', preset: 'balanced', calibrate: 'auto', safety: 'on' }
})
```

devin: docs ask: what do presets map to? we need a small table and an explainer for safety rails (fallbacks, telemetry gating, abort on failed calib). I can draft copy if you give mapping.

sahil: mapping proposal:
- safe = prefer FP16/FP8, disable aggressive int8 kernels, calibrate with >= 500 samples, fallback to fp16 on any calibration failure
- balanced = try int8 on candidate layers with quick calibration (200 samples), allow warmup-only calibration, fallback only on quality regression
- aggressive = try int4/int8 heuristics, calibrate with minimal samples, expose `safety:on` to force rollback on >2% eval metric drift

chloe: QA note — add synthetic KV-warmup tests: sequences with interleaved short/long prefixes to catch kernel ping-pong.

qa: we'll add a nightly perf job that runs the 3 presets over a conv-heavy suite and records p50/p95/p99 + calib time + kernel-switch count.

maya: batching heuristic change idea — only re-evaluate kernel routing if median seq_len changes > 25% OR if kernel_switch_count > 2 within 5s. That should stabilize runtime.

sahil: +1. Also telemetry: record `quant.preset`, `kernels_used`, `kernel_switch_count`, `calib_success` for rollout analysis. Ensure PII-free.

loren: SDK impl notes — keep param names backwards-compatible; default behavior = current stable (no change). Add warnings in client logs when `preset=aggressive`.

devin: docs TODOs: presets table, examples + recommended safety rails, migration guide for existing users, changelog entry about p99 regression and fix strategy.

ops-bot: Canary deploy 1776543000 — quant-int8-rollout v2 started; 2/3 nodes ok, 1 node rolled back.

maya: action items:
1) loren — PR for SDK params + runtime client logs (ETA EOD)
2) sahil — runtime: kernel re-eval heuristic + telemetry (ETA +2d)
3) devin — docs draft for presets + safety rails (ETA +1d)
4) qa — add nightly perf job and synthetic KV-warmup (ETA +3d)

loren: I'll open PRs and tag y'all. :thumbsup:

sahil: I'll push a small perf patch to stop mid-session kernel flips and add a unit to fail the calibration state machine if steps overlap.

maya: sweet. let's not release aggressive preset to prod until we've got 2 full nightly runs without regression.

chloe: noted — I'll monitor canary and post results here.

maya: thanks everyone. keeping this thread as single source for rollout notes. 👍
